tools.name: get_start_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens Quick Event in the user's browser with the event description already filled in. Creates nothing and needs no account: the user reviews the drafted event step by step and only then saves it to a free account. Give the returned url to the user.

tools.name: suggest_modules
tools.description: Recommend which Quick Event modules fit an event (event page, registration, invitations, check-in with badge printing, event app) with current net euro prices per event, and a link to book a demo. Read-only.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_event" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_start_link · Public sink: create_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_start_link · Public sink: create_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
